close_reason: Code already simplified: current helpers.rs has no OnceLock/HashSet/two-pass. Plain nested loop over IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS (21 entries); doc comment already notes HashSet adds no benefit. Issue describes a prior version of the code that no longer exists.
description: helpers.rs lines 83-111: find_immutable_patch_key builds a HashSet<&'static str> for O(1) exact match, but when a match is found it immediately does a second linear scan of IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS just to return a &'static str from the array. The static slice already contains the canonical strings; the HashSet can store them directly. Suggested rewrite: change the OnceLock to OnceLock<HashMap<&'static str, &'static str>> mapping lowercase key -> canonical &'static str, so one lookup returns the canonical value directly without the second pass.
title: find_immutable_patch_key: redundant linear scan after O(1) hash lookup
